# Web / GitHub AI contributor instructions

The **only accepted project-wide policy** is root `AGENTS.md` at Owner-accepted `POLICY_REF`. The web branch or current checkout is not automatically authoritative. Read its current policy and the accepted local Product SoT (via MAR where connected) before proposing product work.

For ChatGPT coordinator read `docs/kit/ORCHESTRATOR.md`; for coding workers read `docs/kit/WORKER.md`. They are adapters, not second policy sources. Don't embed goals, runtime statuses or acceptance claims in permanent workflow instructions. If any checkout/ref is stale or mismatched, stop and report it, without auto merge/push/reset.

Use the Product Progress Gate and bounded tasks in AGENTS.md; no new governance framework or human log relay.
